apks.help: Download the Quest APK (Rave-Racer-VR-Quest-...apk) from itch.io. It is free: choose "No thanks, just take me to the downloads". The Galaxy XR APK on the same page is a different build.

inputs.label: Rave Racer ROM set (raverace.zip or raveracw.zip)
inputs.help: Your own raverace.zip, or a compatible raveracw.zip. Either one is enough. Leave it zipped.

inputs.label: namcoc74.zip and c71.bin
inputs.help: Your own namcoc74.zip (zipped) and the loose c71.bin.

steps.why: The first launch creates the app's files folder under Android/data.

steps.text: Open Rave Racer VR from Library > Unknown Sources and play.

notes: The APK is on itch.io only. The schema cannot say "raverace.zip or raveracw.zip", so the ROM input takes any .zip; QGPUI should check the name is one of the two. File names must match exactly. The payload version v0.1.2-beta matches the guide's v0.1.2 lifecycle-fix APK.
